rule_class: Four relative central cells select a colour; two mirror axes complete that colour. All rules fitting every demonstration must agree on the query.
independent_gate: NumPy colour mask plus np.flip; emitted program paints reflected cells using loops. Neither sees query answers.
counterfactual: Changing demonstration outputs to the other mirror axis changes predictions for the same query input, verified under all eight D4 transforms and a nonidentity palette.
bounded_scope: Evidence identifies predictions within these eight rules, not all possible ARC programs. Native random domain and supplied fixtures certified; arbitrary explicit colors outside native structural assumptions are not.
